note: Every image in deploy/identity/compose.yaml is pinned by the index digest recorded here. A development install re-runs the release and advisory check recorded under advisory_check before it starts, and records the result in docs/design/identity/reports/IDENTITY-001-deployment.md.

rauthy.image_source: The upstream release image of tag v0.36.2, whose tag object is commit dd61ac3c84d6b238108dc8438b53043b5177a662, the exact commit the ablative branch and the vendor/rauthy pin name. While the fork carries no change of its own the release image is the pinned source; the first fork change (row 03) replaces it with an image built from the pin.

postgres.image_source: The Docker Official Image as mirrored at public.ecr.aws; the index digest is the same as docker.io/library/postgres:17.11-bookworm.

rauthy.accepted_exception: v0.36.2 carries no open published advisory, but upstream's later hardening (sebadob/rauthy #1696, merged 2026-08-26, and #1728, merged 2026-09-18) is in no release. Waffles' ruling of 15:36:25 accepts v0.36.2 for isolated development installs with test identities only; IDENTITY-001-UPSTREAM-AUTH-STATE still binds real sign-in (row 06) and install (row 07), and the rebase is IDENTITY-002.
